name: install-upgrade-guide-inline
body: Limit — The layout-upgrade guide `apg init` installs into the project is an inline `const` string literal in `src/install.rs` rather than a single-sourced `include_str!` of a suite file, because `opencode-suite/lib/` carries no `apg-upgrade.md` yet. Upgrade — When that file lands, replace the literal with `include_str!("../opencode-suite/lib/apg-upgrade.md")`, matching `APG_LIB`.
